verdict.rationale: Tavily documents an official MCP server with a first-party hosted endpoint (mcp.tavily.com) that agents can add in one command. It exposes the search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, or any MCP client, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: claude mcp add tavily --transport http https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/
Connect Tavily's search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, VS Code, or any MCP client.
Tavily MCP is also compatible with any MCP client.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/mcp
